headline.title: Overview of HIPE-2026: Person-Place Relation Extraction from Multilingual Historical Texts
headline.summary: HIPE-2026 focuses on extracting person-place relationships from multilingual historical texts, addressing the challenge of determining whether a person was ever at a specific location and when. This third edition of the HIPE evaluation series shifts from named entity recognition to reasoning about relationships between entities, specifically targeting temporally grounded relations.

articles.title: Facebook’s Creator Studio has been revived as an AI companion app
articles.summary: Meta has relaunched Facebook's Creator Studio as a standalone AI companion app designed to assist creators in engaging with their audiences and enhancing their growth on the platform. The app features an AI Creator Assistant that provides tailored guidance for users.

articles.title: British Police Built a Sprawling Crime-Prediction Machine. Some Results Couldn’t Be Trusted
articles.summary: A WIRED investigation uncovers the complexities and challenges faced by British police in implementing a predictive analytics system for crime prediction, revealing issues with the reliability of some results. The findings highlight the difficulties in integrating AI technology into law enforcement practices.

articles.title: How agents are transforming work
articles.summary: A recent OpenAI research paper highlights the impact of AI agents on the workplace, demonstrating their ability to facilitate longer and more complex tasks. The findings suggest that these agents are significantly enhancing productivity across various roles.

articles.title: Introducing computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash
articles.summary: Gemini 3.5 Flash has introduced computer use capabilities, enhancing its functionality for users. This update aims to improve user experience by integrating more advanced features for efficient task management.

articles.title: A24 Knows You’re Mad About the Google AI Collab
articles.summary: A24's recent $75 million investment from Google DeepMind has sparked backlash among indie movie fans concerned about the growing influence of AI in Hollywood. The collaboration highlights ongoing tensions between traditional filmmaking and the increasing role of technology in the industry.

articles.title: Europe is pushing back on Washington’s chip war
articles.summary: European leaders are expressing concerns over the U.S. MATCH Act, which aims to restrict China's access to advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment. ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet highlighted that China currently has access only to older-generation tools, which the proposed legislation would further limit.

articles.title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
articles.summary: Wan-Streamer v0.1 is a new interactive foundation model that enables real-time, low-latency audio-visual interactions by integrating language, audio, and video processing within a single Transformer architecture. The model operates in a full-duplex manner, allowing for simultaneous input and output of interleaved visual, audio, and text tokens.

articles.title: AeroCast: Probabilistic 3D Trajectory Prediction for Non-Cooperative Aerial Obstacles via Transformer-MDN Architecture
articles.summary: AeroCast introduces a Transformer-Mixture Density Network (MDN) architecture for predicting the 3D trajectories of non-cooperative aerial obstacles, addressing the limitations of traditional deterministic models. This approach enhances the ability of autonomous aerial vehicles to anticipate and navigate around unpredictable threats in shared airspace.

articles.title: Heterogeneous and Adept Snapshot Distillation for 3D Semantic Segmentation
articles.summary: The article presents a novel approach called Heterogeneous and Adept Snapshot Distillation aimed at improving 3D semantic segmentation performance by transferring knowledge from multi-modal models without incurring high computational costs. This method addresses the limitations of existing techniques that depend on auxiliary inputs or are computationally expensive.

articles.title: Sarashina2.2-TTS: Tackling Kanji Polyphony in Japanese Speech Generation via Data Scaling and Targeted Data Synthesis
articles.summary: Sarashina2.2-TTS is a new text-to-speech system designed specifically for Japanese, addressing the challenges of kanji polyphony through data scaling and targeted data synthesis. This system aims to enhance speech generation quality in Japanese, which has been less explored compared to English and Chinese in existing TTS technologies.

articles.title: Anatomically-conditioned Latent Diffusion Model for Data-Efficient Few-Shot Cross-Domain 3D Glioma MRI Synthesis
articles.summary: The Anatomically-conditioned Latent Diffusion Model (ALDM) is introduced as a framework for efficient few-shot synthesis of 3D glioma MRI scans, addressing challenges posed by domain shifts and limited annotated datasets. ALDM employs a two-stage method combining a 3D variational autoencoder for anatomical priors and a conditional latent diffusion model for synthesis.
